This role will be central to ensuring that growth is properly funded, commercially controlled and supported by strong financial insight. Očakávame: minimálne 5 rokov skúseností v oblasti Global Mobility, International HR alebo podobnej oblasti, praktickú skúsenosť s relokáciami, imigračnou agendou alebo medzinárodnou mobilitou zamestnancov, dobrú orientáciu v problematike cezhraničného zamestnávania, výborné organizačné a komunikačné schopnosti, schopnosť samostatne riadiť viacero paralelných prípadov, proaktívny a spoľahlivý prístup, plynulú angličtinu, znalosť slovenčiny alebo češtiny, pokročilú znalosť MS Office. Hľadáme preto človeka, ktorý nebude len spracovávať jednotlivé prípady, ale bude aktívne pomáhať nastavovať procesy, prinášať riešenia a zvyšovať kvalitu medzinárodnej mobility v rámci skupiny. Strong financial management expertise, including budgeting, financial controls, compliance, and institutional grant management. Your contact person: Ms. Eve Muthama We would like to further promote diversity in our teams and therefore welcome applications from people of different ethnic and social backgrounds, religions and world views, different ages and genders, and especially from people with disabilities. Suitability is decisive, gender is irrelevant!

review_candidates.description: Commercial Manager We are seeking an accomplished Commercial Manager to take full ownership of the contractual and commercial performance of a major Oil & Gas EPC project. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for protecting contractor entitlement, maximizing commercial recovery, managing project risk, and ensuring the successful delivery of the project's final account and margin. The successful candidate will bring extensive contractor-side experience, a proven track record in claims and commercial recovery, and the ability to lead complex commercial interfaces within EPC, consortium, and subcontracting environments. YOUR ROLE As Commercial Manager , you will Commercial & Contractual Leadership Lead all contractual and commercial administration activities across contractor, consortium/EPC partner, client, PMC, subcontractor, and supplier interfaces. Establish and manage contract obligations, notices, variations, claims, counterclaims, back-charges, and final account strategies. Ensure contractual correspondence and notices are issued accurately, timely, and supported by robust project records. Claims & Entitlement Management Identify, develop, and substantiate entitlement arising from: Scope changes and instructed variations, Delays, disruption, and prolongation, Acceleration measures, Access constraints and resequencing, Additional resources and compensable events Lead negotiation and settlement of variations, claims, disputed items, and final account agreements. Work closely with Project Controls teams to integrate contractual entitlement with planning, cost, productivity, and delay analysis. Commercial Performance Management Own project commercial forecasting, including: Revenue, Cost-to-complete (ETC), Estimate at Completion (EAC), Cash flow, Commitments and liabilities, Forecast final margin Review subcontractor applications, variations, claims, and final accounts to mitigate unsupported costs and commercial leakage. Develop and implement commercial recovery strategies to maximize project profitability and cash generation. Leadership & Reporting Chair commercial review meetings and provide executive-level reporting on risks, opportunities, recovery actions, and forecast outcomes. Mentor Quantity Surveyors and commercial team members, ensuring consistency in measurement, valuation, record keeping, and contract administration. Drive commercial close-out and final account settlement activities. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience 20+ years of industry experience, including at least 10-12 years in senior commercial or contracts leadership roles Strong contractor-side experience on major Oil & Gas EPC or construction projects Experience working with: International EPC Contractors, Joint Venture (JV) / Consortium projects, Large subcontract and supplier networks. Demonstrated responsibility for: Major claims management, EOT assessments, Prolongation and disruption claims, Variations and final accounts. Proven success in recovering margin and cash flow on delayed, distressed, or late-stage projects Experience on large-scale projects valued at US$500M+ ADNOC project experience (preferred) Education and Certifications Degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Commercial Management, or related discipline Skills and Competencies Strong expertise in: Commercial forecasting, Cost-to-complete analysis, Cash flow management, Executive commercial reporting Working knowledge of Primavera P6 and ability to connect schedule impacts to commercial entitlement Outstanding contractual writing, negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills WHAT WE OFFER The chance to contribute to some of UAE’s Oil and Gas EPC Mega projects. A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Competitive salary and benefits package. Ready to be part of our team? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success. Apply today and be part of something excellent!

review_candidates.title: Cluster Lead Humanitarian Action (d/f/m)
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a new team member for our International Programmes Division, Cluster Humanitarian Action, in Hamburg as soon as possible Cluster Lead Humanitarian Action (d/f/m) - unlimited / full time (39 hours per week) - Plan International is an independent organisation for development cooperation and humanitarian aid. Our goal is for girls and boys worldwide to have equal rights and opportunities and to actively shape their future. To achieve this, we implement efficient and transparent projects for sustainable community development in our partner countries and respond swiftly to emergencies and disasters that threaten children's lives. In over 75 countries, we work hand in hand with children, youth, supporters, and partners of all genders to achieve our global goals. The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals strengthen our commitment. Plan is committed to safeguarding. Your tasks Leading the humanitarian cluster and providing strategic steering and overall responsibility for the humanitarian project portfolio, ensuring its strategic direction, performance, impact, and future viability Contributing to the strategic development of the International Programmes Division and actively collaborating within the International Programmes Management Team, aligning cluster activities with the division's strategic goals Strategically steering the cluster portfolio (including income planning, matching funds, and fundraising appeals), holding overarching programmatic and financial-administrative responsibility, and assuming responsibility for the proposal phase within the end-to-end process, including quality assurance Driving business development to open up new funding streams, including a fundraising strategy with growth ambition and income forecasting, and steering fund acquisition with the assigned donors (strategic donor lead; focus on AA, KOA, BMZ ÜH, ECHO) as well as managing and further developing assigned Global Accounts (ECHO, WFP) Providing technical and disciplinary leadership of the team, planning staff resources across the cluster, managing workload, and steering personnel-administrative measures in close collaboration with People & Culture, while fostering an inclusive and appreciative working culture Strengthening the humanitarian profile of Plan International Germany, strategically contributing current system topics (HDP nexus, Core Humanitarian Standard, Grand Bargain), building strategic relationships with humanitarian donors and partners, and representing the organisation in relevant forums and networks (national: VENRO, Humanitarian Aid Coordination Committee; international: VOICE, ICVA) Representing the organisation's values in daily decisions and behaviour, and complying with legal and organisational requirements Your profile Successfully completed university degree (Master's) in a development/ humanitarian-related field At least 7 years of professional experience in international cooperation and/or humanitarian assistance, transitional aid, and disaster risk reduction Sound knowledge of the humanitarian system (HDP nexus, Core Humanitarian Standard, coordination, financing, Grand Bargain) and of the humanitarian donor landscape (in particular AA, BMZ ÜH, ECHO, WFP) Expertise in portfolio and project management, including fund acquisition, proposal development, compliance, and quality assurance Knowledge of the international institutional and private donor landscape, as well as of personnel management and organisational development Several years of leadership experience (technical and disciplinary), strong communication and negotiation skills, networking ability, and intercultural and diplomatic competence Resilience, integrity, and a structured, goal-oriented way of working in demanding humanitarian contexts; willingness to travel; very good command of English, both written and spoken We offer you A flexible working hours model and up to 12 days of mobile work per month 30 vacation days based on a 5-day work week A subsidy for the “Deutschlandticket”, the company pension plan, and the in-house canteen/cafeteria (in Hamburg) A company laptop and a subsidy for home office equipment Exciting responsibilities and a modern, ergonomic working environment The actions of Plan International Deutschland e.V. are guided by our values of solidarity, tolerance, freedom, equality, and justice. We embrace diversity and therefore explicitly welcome applications from all members of society. If you are interested in this challenging role, please apply in English and include your salary expectations and earliest possible start date online.
